en.title: Pennsylvania oil and gas wells mapped by Inside Climate News and Pittsburgh Post-Gazette
en.dek: Abandoned Pennsylvania oil and gas wells have been mapped through a collaboration between Inside Climate News and the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette.
facts: Pennsylvania has a long history of oil and gas exploration dating back to 1859 when Edwin Drake struck oil.
The mapping project was a collaboration between Inside Climate News and the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette.
Western Pennsylvania's geology resembles a huge block of Swiss cheese due to its long history of oil and gas exploration.
body: Abandoned oil and gas wells across Pennsylvania have been mapped through a collaboration between Inside Climate News and the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette.
Western Pennsylvania's geology resembles a huge block of Swiss cheese due to its long history of oil and gas exploration.
en.context: Pennsylvania's oil and gas industry began in 1859 with the first oil well drilled by Edwin Drake.
en.imageCaption: B’Yachad party leader Naftali Bennett leaving Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's office after nearly three-hour meeting, November 18, 2026.

de.title: Pennsylvania-Öl- und Gasbrunnen von Inside Climate News und Pittsburgh Post-Gazette kartiert
de.dek: Abgegebene Pennsylvania-Öl- und Gasbrunnen wurden durch eine Zusammenarbeit von Inside Climate News und der Pittsburgh Post-Gazette kartiert.
facts: Pennsylvania hat eine lange Geschichte der Öl- und Gasförderung, die bis ins Jahr 1859 zurückgeht, als Edwin Drake Öl förderte.
Das Kartierungsprojekt war eine Zusammenarbeit zwischen Inside Climate News und der Pittsburgh Post-Gazette.
Die Geologie West-Pennsylvanias ähnelt einem riesigen Schweizer Käseblock aufgrund ihrer langen Geschichte der Öl- und Gasförderung.
body: Abandonierte Öl- und Gasbrunnen in Pennsylvania wurden in Zusammenarbeit zwischen Inside Climate News und der Pittsburgh Post-Gazette kartiert.
Die Geologie West-Pennsylvanias gleicht einem riesigen Schweizer Käse aufgrund ihrer langen Geschichte der Öl- und Gasförderung.
de.context: Pennsylvania's Öl- und Gasindustrie begann 1859 mit der ersten von Edwin Drake gebohrten Ölbohrung.
de.imageCaption: B’Yachad-Parteichef Naftali Bennett verlässt das Büro von Ministerpräsident Benjamin Netanyahu nach einem fast dreistündigen Treffen am 18. November 2026.

zh.title: 宾夕法尼亚州油气井被《Inside Climate News》和《匹兹堡邮报》绘制地图
zh.dek: 废弃的宾夕法尼亚州油气井通过《Inside Climate News》和《匹兹堡邮报》的合作项目被绘制地图
facts: 宾夕法尼亚州石油和天然气勘探历史可追溯至1859年艾德温·德雷克发现石油
该绘图项目是《Inside Climate News》和《匹兹堡邮报》合作的结果
西部宾夕法尼亚州的地质结构因悠久的石油和天然气勘探历史而宛如巨大的瑞士奶酪
body: 废弃的油气井遍布宾夕法尼亚州，这是《Inside Climate News》和《匹兹堡邮报》合作绘制的地图。
西部宾夕法尼亚州的地质结构如同一块巨大的瑞士奶酪，这是因为其漫长的油气勘探历史。
zh.context: 宾夕法尼亚州的石油和天然气工业始于1859年艾德温·德雷克钻探的首口油井
zh.imageCaption: 图片说明：Naftali Bennett（B’Yachad党领袖）在近三小时的会晤后离开本雅明·内塔尼亚胡总理办公室，日期为2026年11月18日

ko.title: 펜실베이니아 주, 인사이드 클라이밋 뉴스와 피츠버그 포스트-가제트 공동으로 유·가스 웰 지도화

facts: 펜실베이니아 주는 1859년 에드윈 드레이크가 석유를 발견한 이래 오랜 석유·가스 탐사 역사를 가짐
인사이드 클라이밋 뉴스와 피츠버그 포스트-가제트가 협업한 지도화 프로젝트
서부 펜실베이니아 지질, 오랜 석유·가스 탐사 탓에 거대한 스위스 치즈처럼 보임
body: 버려진 석유와 가스 웰이 인사이드 클라이밋 뉴스와 피츠버그 포스트-가제트의 협업을 통해 지도화되었습니다.
서부 펜실베이니아의 지질은 오랜 석유·가스 탐사 역사로 인해 거대한 스위스 치즈와 비슷합니다.
ko.context: 펜실베이니아 주 석유·가스 산업은 1859년 에드윈 드레이크가 처음으로 유정을 드릴링하면서 시작됨

es.title: Pozo y gas de Pennsylvania mapeados por Inside Climate News y Pittsburgh Post-Gazette
es.dek: Pozos abandonados de petróleo y gas de Pennsylvania han sido mapeados a través de una colaboración entre Inside Climate News y el Pittsburgh Post-Gazette.
facts: Pennsylvania tiene una larga historia de exploración de petróleo y gas que se remonta a 1859, cuando Edwin Drake descubrió petróleo.
El proyecto de mapeo fue una colaboración entre Inside Climate News y el Pittsburgh Post-Gazette.

La geología del oeste de Pennsylvania se parece a un enorme bloque de queso suizo debido a su larga historia de exploración de petróleo y gas. @@CONTEXT__ Pennsylvania's oil and gas industry began in 1859 with the first oil well drilled by Edwin Drake. @@CAPTION__ B’Yachad party leader Naftali Bennett leaving Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's office after nearly three-hour meeting, November 18, 2026.
body: Pozo y gas abandonados en Pennsylvania han sido mapeados a través de una colaboración entre Inside Climate News y el Pittsburgh Post-Gazette.
La geología de Western Pennsylvania se asemeja a un enorme bloque de queso suizo debido a su larga historia de exploración de petróleo y gas.

pt.title: Poços de petróleo e gás da Pensilvânia mapeados pela Inside Climate News e Pittsburgh Post-Gazette
pt.dek: Poços de petróleo e gás abandonados da Pensilvânia foram mapeados através de uma colaboração entre a Inside Climate News e o Pittsburgh Post-Gazette.
facts: A Pensilvânia tem uma longa história de exploração de petróleo e gás desde 1859, quando Edwin Drake encontrou petróleo
O projeto de mapeamento foi uma colaboração entre a Inside Climate News e o Pittsburgh Post-Gazette
A geologia da Pensilvânia ocidental assemelha-se a um grande bloco de queijo suíço devido à sua longa história de exploração de petróleo e gás.
body: Poços de petróleo e gás abandonados em toda a Pensilvânia foram mapeados através de uma colaboração entre a Inside Climate News e o Pittsburgh Post-Gazette.
A geologia da Pensilvânia Ocidental assemelha-se a um grande bloco de queijo suíço devido à sua longa história de exploração de petróleo e gás.
pt.context: A indústria de petróleo e gás da Pensilvânia começou em 1859 com o primeiro poço de petróleo perfurado por Edwin Drake.
pt.imageCaption: O líder do partido B’Yachad, Naftali Bennett, a sair do gabinete do Primeiro-Ministro Benjamin Netanyahu após uma reunião de quase três horas, 18 de novembro de 2026.

ja.title: ペンシルベニア州の石油・ガス井戸をInside Climate Newsとピッツバーグ・ポスト・ガゼットが地図化
ja.dek: 廃止されたペンシルベニア州の石油・ガス井戸について、Inside Climate Newsとピッツバーグ・ポスト・ガゼットが共同で地図を作成した
facts: ペンシルベニア州は1859年にエドウィン・ドレイクが石油を発見して以来、長きにわたる石油・ガス探査の歴史を持つ
この地図作成プロジェクトはInside Climate Newsとピッツバーグ・ポスト・ガゼットの共同事業であった
西ペンシルベニア州の地質は、長年の石油・ガス探査の歴史により、巨大なスイスチーズのような形状をしている
body: ペンシルベニア州の放棄された石油・ガス井戸が、Inside Climate Newsとピッツバーグ・ポスト・ガゼットの共同で地図化された。
西ペンシルベニア州の地質は、長年の石油・ガス探査の歴史により、巨大なスイスチーズのような様相を呈している。
ja.context: ペンシルベニア州の石油・ガス産業は、エドウィン・ドレイクによる最初の油井掘削で1859年に始まった
ja.imageCaption: B’Yachad党の指導者ナフタリ・ベネット氏が、ベンヤミン・ネタニヤフ首相との約3時間の会談後、彼の執務室を出る様子（2026年11月18日）

fr.dek: Des puits de pétrole et de gaz abandonnés en Pennsylvanie ont été cartographiés grâce à une collaboration entre Inside Climate News et le Pittsburgh Post-Gazette.
facts: La Pennsylvanie a une longue histoire d'exploration pétrolière et gazière remontant à 1859 avec la découverte d'Edwin Drake
Le projet de cartographie était une collaboration entre Inside Climate News et le Pittsburgh Post-Gazette
La géologie de l'ouest de la Pennsylvanie ressemble à un immense bloc de fromage suisse en raison de sa longue histoire d'exploration pétrolière et gazière
body: Des puits de pétrole et de gaz abandonnés en Pennsylvanie ont été cartographiés grâce à une collaboration entre Inside Climate News et le Pittsburgh Post-Gazette.
La géologie de l'ouest de la Pennsylvanie ressemble à un immense bloc de fromage suisse en raison de son histoire longue d'exploration pétrolière et gazière.
fr.context: L'industrie pétrolière et gazière de Pennsylvanie a débuté en 1859 avec le premier puits de pétrole foré par Edwin Drake
fr.imageCaption: Le chef du parti B’Yachad, Naftali Bennett, quittant le bureau du Premier ministre Benjamin Netanyahu après une réunion de près de trois heures, le 18 novembre 2026.

it.title: Pozzi petroliferi e del gas della Pennsylvania mappati da Inside Climate News e Pittsburgh Post-Gazette
it.dek: Sono stati mappati i pozzi petroliferi e del gas abbandonati della Pennsylvania grazie a una collaborazione tra Inside Climate News e Pittsburgh Post-Gazette.
facts: La Pennsylvania ha una lunga storia di esplorazione di petrolio e gas risalente al 1859, quando Edwin Drake scoprì il petrolio
Il progetto di mappatura è stato una collaborazione tra Inside Climate News e Pittsburgh Post-Gazette
La geologia della Pennsylvania occidentale assomiglia a un grande blocco di formaggio svizzero a causa della sua lunga storia di esplorazione di petrolio e gas
body: Pozzi petroliferi e del gas abbandonati in Pennsylvania sono stati mappati grazie a una collaborazione tra Inside Climate News e Pittsburgh Post-Gazette.
La geologia della Pennsylvania occidentale assomiglia a un grande blocco di formaggio svizzero a causa della sua lunga storia di esplorazione di petrolio e gas.
it.context: L'industria petrolifera e del gas della Pennsylvania è iniziata nel 1859 con il primo pozzo petrolifero trivellato da Edwin Drake.
it.imageCaption: Il leader del partito B’Yachad Naftali Bennett lascia l'ufficio del Primo Ministro Benjamin Netanyahu dopo un incontro di quasi tre ore, 18 novembre 2026.

Stern preservation plea which is not in the provided sources (S1 only covers abandoned wells mapping); headline exceeds 90 characters; body contains unsupported claims about methane leaking and environmental risks not explicitly stated in S1; opening paragraph repeats same noun 'Abandoned' that opened previous paragraph; context section contains evaluative framing ('pose environmental risks'); body paragraph 2 contains unsupported claim about 'dense concentration of wells creates significant environmental and safety hazards'; closing context sentence is evaluative ('reflects ongoing concerns'); multiple filler phrases and vague language; body ends with evaluative summary sentence; headline references Stern which is unsourced
